mechanism_narrative: A sustained downward trend in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of declining FEDFUNDS are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals a weakening labor market and potential economic slowdown, prompting expectations of aggressive monetary easing that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.0%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and industrial production indicates a broad-based economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as recession fears intensify.
failure_condition: The interaction between HOUST and INDPRO does not produce negative returns in more than 60% of cases when both series decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve is expected to maintain restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as real rates remain elevated.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in non-farm payroll employment signals a strong labor market and robust economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with rising PAYEMS, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1400 thousand units, it indicates weakening consumer demand for housing, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic activity slows.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1400, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in consumer credit (RSAFS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signals a deteriorating consumer financial health and labor market, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between RSAFS decline and UNRATE rise does not produce negative returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During recessionary regimes (defined by two consecutive months of INDPRO below 95), the Federal Reserve is expected to implement aggressive monetary stimulus, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as equity valuations adjust to lower discount rates.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95 for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.
